description: Test suite for sandbox tool policy functions using Vitest framework; verifies configuration merging, policy resolution, and filesystem root expansion logic.

methods.name: pickSandboxToolPolicy
methods.description: Determines the sandbox tool policy based on configuration, merging allow and alsoAllow entries, passing through deny as-is.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the effective tool policy considering the global configuration and agent-specific overrides.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolFsRootExpansionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if filesystem root expansion is allowed based on the configuration.

ctags.name: resolved
ctags.pattern: /^    const resolved = resolveEffectiveToolPolicy({ config: cfg, agentId: "main" });$/
